answer: Forging N identities costs N times the bond plus attestation fees, making mass fakery economically irrational, like chasing a comet that burns fuel for no orbit. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded reputation slot: each agent locks a violet-tagged bond before joining an epoch, and peers attest only after verifying the bond on-chain. Reputation then grows along a vine of verified peer attestations, so cheap throwaway identities never accumulate trust and are pruned each epoch. In practice, qwe0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
